lesson: Approval and write effects: include at most ONE task requiring approval per plan. A write, network or process effect needs an exact request hash grant. Each approval re-attempts the plan from its first task because there is no resume, so a second ungranted effect forces an already-completed write to run again, and files.write uses exclusive creation so the retry fails EEXIST. A plan with two ungranted approval-requiring effects can never complete and is refused with PLAN_UNEXECUTABLE. Sequence several writes as separate plans, one approval each. The approval hash binds the resolved input, so the operator sees the real value rather than an unresolved reference.
